title: Financial Reform and Public Good Provision: Municipal Bankruptcy Law and the Financing of Hospitals
eligible_reason: Staggered state-level authorization of Chapter 9 municipal bankruptcy (postCH9 = 1 from the state's authorization year onward, absorbing). Within the 1990-2016 regression windows 19 states are already treated in 1990 (always-treated), 8 states adopt at 6 distinct dates (1993, 1994, 1995 x3, 1996, 2007, 2010) with pre- and post-periods observed, and 23 states never adopt. Table 4 column 1 (bond spreads) and Table 5 column 1 (hospital-purpose issuance) are static TWFE regressions with state and year FE, no controls, two-way clustered by state and year. Table 6 adds a time-varying control (lasset) in every column; Tables 7-8 interact the treatment with continuous exposure.
design_notes: Package replication_package_MS-FIN-20-03523: README.txt; two do-files (masterfile_1_DataGeneration.do builds from InputData/, masterfile_2_Regression.do runs Tables 2-11 and figures from Regression/*.dta). All regression-ready files are shipped including the Mergent-derived bond file MS_FIN_20_03523R1_T4.dta (1,509,041 bonds; the README says the commercial Mergent/Compustat raw data cannot be posted, but the processed regression files are present). Variables: stateid (2-letter), year, postCH9, cspread_ty, amt_bb, nrevenue, stateyear, lagged state controls (l1*), bond controls. T7 file covers 1959-2020 and shows 14 adoption years in total across 27 adopting states; the 1990-2016 window used in Tables 4-5 leaves 6 distinct in-window adoption years. No modern estimator code; Figure 2-3 use a synthetic-control-style comparison (6_synth_* input files) plotted from CSVs.

specs.outcome: cspread_ty (offering yield minus maturity-matched Treasury yield)
specs.treatment_definition: 1 if bond issued in state-year on or after the state's Chapter 9 authorization year (CH9startyear), 0 otherwise; never 0 after adoption
specs.unit_var: stateid (bond-level repeated cross-section assigned to issuing state)
specs.sample_condition: all municipal bonds in Mergent sample, 1990-2016 (N=1,509,041)
specs.notes: Column 2 adds bond controls (lamt lmaturity bondratingInvGrade ntaxed nbondinsurance); column 3 adds lagged state controls; columns 4-6 use state-year FE with postCH9rev/nrevenue interactions (ineligible).

specs.outcome: amt_bb (aggregate hospital-purpose municipal issuance amount, $bn, by state-year-bond type)
specs.treatment_definition: 1 if year >= state's Chapter 9 authorization year
specs.unit_var: stateid (two rows per state-year: nrevenue=0 GO bonds, nrevenue=1 revenue bonds; state FE in code)
specs.sample_condition: 50 states x 27 years x 2 bond types (N=2,700)
specs.notes: For CSA/BJS the stable unit should be state x nrevenue (or collapse to state-year). Column 2 adds lagged state controls; columns 3-5 add postCH9rev + nrevenue interaction (ineligible).

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying control lasset (log hospital assets) in every Table 6 column; columns 3-5 add ch9_cond2_1/cond2_1 interactions with state-year FE
specs.notes: would be eligible without lasset; only 1996-2016 so 25 states already treated at sample start

specs.exclusion_reason: postCH9 interacted with continuous construction-muni share (l1muni_constr_famt) and singlestate20; time-varying firm/state controls
specs.outcome: dlrevt dloibdp dlcapx dlre dlche (T7); dlrgdp_* (T8)
specs.controls: lat bleverage mbratio / lagged state controls

data_access: partial (processed regression files shipped, including Mergent-derived bond data; raw Mergent and Compustat not postable per README)
screener_notes: Full text unavailable; table/column mapping taken from do-file comments (Table 4 = spreads, Table 5 = issue amount, Table 6 = hospital investment). Published coefficients could not be recorded. Check in the article whether Table 4/5 column 1 are indeed reported without controls and whether the published sample matches N=1,509,041 and N=2,700. Code clusters two-way (stateid year).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: 6 distinct in-window adoption years (1993, 1994, 1995, 1996, 2007, 2010; 8 states) in the 1990-2016 bond and issuance samples; 19 states treated before 1990 (always treated); 23 never treated. In the 1996-2016 hospital sample (Table 6) only 2007 and 2010 adoptions remain in-window.
preferred_spec_note: Table 4 is the first ex-post consequences table (bond spreads); column 1 is the no-controls baseline. Unverified without article text.
